basic_profile.bio: I am a 34-year-old freelance accountant living in the outskirts of Seattle. I have a passion for numbers and love helping people navigate the often confusing world of taxes. When I'm not crunching numbers, you can find me tending to my collection of aroids or indulging in a good fantasy novel. I prefer to browse Reddit late at night after my work is done. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom it brings to explore my diverse interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in accounting and over 10 years of experience handling various clients' taxes, I have a solid understanding of US tax laws. I keep myself updated through online courses and forums, ensuring I can provide accurate advice.
